messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Vantage wants to burst ~3x their reserved pool for next Tue promo window (2h). Asking for quota bump + autoscale fallback. Can we run a quick loadtest today? cc @ravi_eng @tom_sre @lina_sales :eyes:

ravi_eng: Which reserved pool id and model profile? need seq length, expected avg tokens/req to size batching. Also any KMS/priv data concerns?

maria_cs: Pool: rv-231. Model: redwood-1.5b-quant, seq avg 120 tokens, ~10k req/min target for burst => ~1.2M tokens/min peak. No private keys, just customer prompts.

tom_sre: Pinged staging autoscaler to ensure warm nodes available. If they truly hit 3x commit we should validate fallback to hosted region. I can run a smoke with synthetic traffic, 10m run.

lina_sales: FYI customer accepted provisional overage pricing but wants minimal user impact. Need docs for billing heads-up to finance. Can CS confirm the exact hours?

maria_cs: Promo window 2024-09-10 14:00-16:00 UTC. Customer will send a test webhook 5m before.

ravi_eng: Ok. Plan: 1) run 10m dark loadtest on rv-231 in staging with same model and seq dist. 2) verify autoscale triggers and latency SLOs. 3) test hosted fallback where traffic > reserved cap — ensure correct response codes and sticky routing. 4) capture KV cache warmup timing.

ops-bot: deploy-bot noticed a scheduled infra deploy at 2024-09-09T22:00Z for the region hosting rv-231. Recommend we coordinate to avoid noise during test window.

tom_sre: Good catch. I'll ask infra to postpone or gate that deploy.

maria_cs: Can someone run the loadtest now (within the hour)? Customer wants earlier validation. I can hold their test webhook until after our dry-run.

ravi_eng: I'll kick off the runner from my laptop. Quick script I'm using:

```bash
# synthetic load for redwood-1.5b-quant on pool rv-231
loadtest --pool rv-231 --model redwood-1.5b-quant --qps 10000 --duration 600 --seq-avg 120 --out results/vantage-dryrun.json
```

ravi_eng: Will watch autoscale logs and token counters. Tagging @tom_sre for SLO/alert watch.

tom_sre: Watching. If tail latency climbs >500ms for 95th we abort and scale manual. Also will validate fallback responses (503 vs 200 with hosted model).

lina_sales: I'll prep the billing note for finance and draft the customer-facing summary once we have results.

maria_cs: Thanks. Action items: 
- ravi_eng: run loadtest now and attach results (due in 20m)
- tom_sre: monitor autoscaler + abort criteria (ongoing)
- lina_sales: draft billing note + customer summary (standby)
- maria_cs: coordinate webhook timing with Vantage and confirm final hours

maria_cs: If the dry-run passes, we should schedule a brief runbook run-through with customer (10m) to ensure they know the webhook timing and backoff behavior. :white_check_mark:

ravi_eng: Starting loadtest now. will post results and a short log snippet when done.

(20m later)
ravi_eng: Dry-run done. Quick highlights: autoscaler fired 2x by minute 3, latency 95p stayed ~380ms, avg token cost within expected range. KV cache primed by minute 6. Posting summary: results/vantage-dryrun.json (uploaded).

tom_sre: Verified alerts: no incident-level alarms. Fallback test: when we artificially capped reserved pool, requests routed to hosted model with 200 responses and slightly higher latency (~620ms 95p) — acceptable per SLO fallback policy.

lina_sales: Drafted billing note and customer summary, prepping to send once CS confirms.

maria_cs: Excellent work team. I'll send the summary to Vantage, propose the plan to bump commit for the 2h window, and include the fallback/backstop details. Closing this thread after I get customer ack. :pray:

ops-bot: note — create ticket CS-1428 for post-promo retrospective and quota reconciliation.
